android.desc: The era of expensive roaming and rigid telecom contracts is over. Numero provides you with telecom services, combining instant international virtual SIM data, virtual numbers, and affordable international calls into a single, powerful eSIM service. Stop sacrificing privacy or overpaying for connectivity. Whether you're a frequent traveler, a small business owner, or simply need a secure second line, Numero gives you the freedom and flexibility you deserve. Why Numero? 📱Virtual 2nd numbers Need another mobile number or landline for work, travel, business, WhatsApp Business, marketplace chats, freelance, toll free, or privacy? Numero eSIM lets you add second or multiple numbers without switching or removing your SIM. Choose numbers from many countries, including a USA phone number. A virtual SIM works through the cloud anywhere in the world. Choose a number to: • Receive SMS and calls only. • Receive and send SMS and make calls. Add credit later if you need outgoing SMS or calling. WhatsApp: Not every Numero eSIM number supports WhatsApp. If you need WhatsApp, choose a number from the dedicated WhatsApp-compatible section in the app. Free phone number: Collect coins in the Free Coins Center to get a US number free for one month. Collect coins again to renew it. These numbers do not support WhatsApp. Toll-free numbers let customers call you without call charges. Numero eSIM toll-free numbers offer up to 5 lines, no setup fees, low number subscription costs, no long-term commitment, and affordable outgoing calls. ✈️Travel data & full eSIMs Going abroad and don't want expensive roaming, SIM swapping, store searches, or removing your SIM? Manage your connectivity in Numero eSIM. Choose from these data eSIMs: • Local eSIMs for single-country trips. • Regional eSIMs for multi-country trips. • Global eSIMs covering 120+ countries in one eSIM. • Unlimited eSIMs, terms apply. Activate before you fly by scanning a QR code, then connect after landing. A Data eSIM is data-only: no phone number for regular calls or SMS. You can still call and message through internet apps such as WhatsApp, Telegram, and FaceTime. A Full eSIM combines a real phone number, eSIM mobile data, SMS, and calling minutes, letting you call, text, and browse from one eSIM. 🌍Affordable international calls Want to stay connected to home without expensive roaming?
